messages:
ana: Quick check — vendor just flagged a partial backorder on the H100s for the dedicated pool. Can procurement/share vendor ETA? We need to decide if we accept partial shipment or switch to A100s for the Q2 demo cluster. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4592

mike_procurement: FYI pinged vendor this morning. Their message: 'manufacturing backlog, earliest partial shipment 2–3 weeks, full fulfillment 5–7 weeks.' They offered to split the order into 4x immediate + remainder later. No firm cross-shipping ETA yet.

sara_eng: If we take the 4x partial now, can infra reserve them for the canary pool? We need ~6 GPUs for the demo canary, so 4 isn't enough on its own.

james_sre: We can reserve the 4 for the canary and borrow 2 from demo-burst queue temporarily. Need an ops ticket so we don't accidentally autoscale them away.

leo_ops: @james_sre created ops ticket OPS-1123 to pin devices during canary window. Also added a note to prevent reclaim for 72h after allocation.

vendor_julia: Apologies for the delay — confirmed partial shipment option is on the table. If you accept partial, we'll prioritize 4 H100 cards in the next available crate and ship to our west-coast DC. Shipping ETA once crate assigned (48–72h from allocation).

ana_typo: (reaction :eyes:)

ana_fix: sorry, ignore previous typo :sweat_smile:

ana: (actual note) Thanks @vendor_julia. Two quick followups: 1) can the partial shipment be configured as a dedicated pool with tenant tag training-dedicated so we can route only demo traffic to them? 2) Can procurement add a contingency to swap to 8x A100s if the remainder slips past 6 weeks?

mike_procurement: We can request tagging at vendor side but will need transport+onboarding time. Contingency swap to A100s is doable but pricing/firmware differences may add ~48h to install+validation. I'll add both asks to INF-4592 and request approval from finance for price delta.

sara_eng: For the quota bump — ops needs a formal quota request so cloud IAM + quota managers can approve. Run this script and paste the output here:```./infra/tools/request_quota.sh --project training-dedicated --region us-west2 --gpus 8 --type h100``` If the vendor ships partial, we'll update the requested amount accordingly.

ana: ran the script, output attached: "Request queued: 8 H100s in us-west2 — request id Q-9082"

devproc_bot: Created procurement subtask INF-4592-1 (partial-ship-4x) and quota request Q-9082 linked. Assigned: mike_procurement, leo_ops.

james_sre: Quick code-review-ish ops note: when onboarding different SKU (H100 vs A100) remember to run the kernel tuning job and the nvlink health check. Small checklist: 1) validate driver 525+ 2) run nvlink diag 3) update gpu-affinity tags. I'll drop a short runbook in OPS-1123.

leo_ops: Copying checklist into OPS-1123 now. Also pinging infra-sre for canary rollout window — propose Tues 10am PT.

ana: Tuesday 10am PT works for the demo timeline. If procurement confirms crate allocation today we'll accept the 4x partial and proceed with the temporary borrow for the rest. Thanks all — keeping INF-4592 updated with approvals. :thumbsup:

mike_procurement: Noted. Will update INF-4592 by EOD with vendor allocation confirmation or next steps.

vendor_julia: I'll push for crate allocation today and confirm shipping manifest once assigned.

james_sre: one more: @sara_eng please add the canary routes to the routing policy so fallback to preemptible pool is automatic if we see eviction spikes during demo.

sara_eng: on it, will add route + test in staging by Monday.

ana: awesome — closing the loop here. If anything changes, @mike_procurement please drop a quick note in this thread so we can push to demo owners.
